title: Reduced 5 stars to 1
text: Reduced 5 stars to 1. Dryer/Fire risk!  Previously  I wrote a lovely glowing review for this comforter.  Even tho it is a comforter I had covered it with a cotton duvet cover so this is the first time since my purchase that I have washed and tried to dry it. Per the website and the label I put in my dryer on the “low” setting. 3 minutes later while loading my washing machine a foot away I smelled something burning.  Too late I realized it was my comforter!  It’s also stuck to the inside of my dryer.  I’m a disabled veteran and I live on a fixed income so losing a purchase like this hits my pocket book pretty hard.  It is snowing in Colorado today or I would have hung this to dry, but alas I followed the seller’s website instructions and their label on the comforter.  Sadly, I see no warranty information at all.  The comforter was lovely. If you buy it do not try to dry it as per the instructions!
